doctrine: Remotion is a React-based framework for programmatic video creation. Integrates with Claude Code as an official skill. Core workflow: prompt → code → rendered video. Installation via `npx create-video@latest` and Claude Code skill integration. Best practices for AI video output: (1) Clear output specification with scene breakdown, (2) Provide reference material (creative brief, assets, images, links), (3) Chunk work incrementally (section-by-section iteration), (4) Refine via targeted prompts (transitions, colors, animations). MCP install via @remotion/mcp@latest. Use plan/execute mode for better context understanding. Strengths: speed (5-10 min prototype), reusability, programmatic power, asset integration (GitHub images, custom colors, animations). Limitations: visual reasoning quirks, requires iteration/tweaks for polish, best for structured content (product demos, explainers, social shorts, real estate listings, fitness tracking, team performance data). Examples: property listing videos, sports team overviews, travel animations, fitness journey tracking, idea validation videos with CTAs. Post-iteration workflow: screenshot specific slides, paste into prompt, request targeted refinements (typography, color scheme, transitions, glow effects).
workflows: Prompt to code to rendered video
Asset integration from GitHub or local sources
prompts: Create an overview explainer video with icons and animations for [project/repo]
Improve transitions to match industry best practice
Change color scheme from [current] to [target] (e.g., purple/blue to neutral palette)
Pull in images from [source] and utilize them in the video
Make this slide look [describe target aesthetic]
tools: Claude Code boot for project execution
operating_rules: Use Remotion like creative directors, not autopilot
Provide clear output specification before generation
Include reference material (creative brief, assets, links)
Use plan mode first to ensure Claude understands context and skills
Iterate with targeted, visual feedback (screenshot + specific refinement requests)
Set up local dev server (`npm run dev`) to preview changes in browser before committing
Expect and plan for 1-2 rounds of refinement for polish
Use Tailwind CSS option for styling consistency
content_ideas: Product demo videos for SaaS (30-60 sec explainers)
Real estate property listing videos with feature highlights and CTAs
Fitness journey tracking animations with audio overlay
Team/league performance dashboards with animated charts and maps
Business idea validation videos with branded CTAs and color schemes
Travel animation videos (e.g., route maps with icons and transitions)
Social media shorts (LinkedIn, Instagram automation for 24/7 uploads)
Educational explainers with icon animations and call-to-action
Before/after case study videos with data visualization
